endScreen.watchReplay.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. A secondary button on the after-battle report: plays back the battle just fought. Short button label; "replay" means a recorded playback of the battle.

endScreen.downloadReplay.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. A secondary button on the after-battle report: saves the battle's recording as a file. Short button label.

garage.record.tab.replays.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. A tab in the Service Record dialog listing saved battle recordings (replays). One word, as short as the English.

garage.record.replaysEmpty.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. Shown in the Service Record's replays tab when no recording is saved yet: solo battles are recorded and listed there. One short sentence.

garage.record.replayWatch.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. A small button on one saved replay's row: plays that recording. One word.

garage.record.replayDownload.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. A small button on one saved replay's row: saves that recording as a file. One word.

replay.play.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Button: resume playback. One word.

replay.pause.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Button: pause playback. One word.

replay.speed.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Label for the playback speed control (0.5x, 1x, 2x). One word.

replay.timeline.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar. Accessible name of the bar and of its track, the strip that shows the battle's events in time order and that you drag to seek. One or two words.

replay.leave.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Button: close the viewer and return to the game.

replay.previousMark.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Button: jump back to the previous marked event on the timeline (a kill, a hit, a fire).

replay.nextMark.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Button: jump ahead to the next marked event on the timeline.

replay.frameBack.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Button: step the playback back by one simulation frame.

replay.frameForward.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Button: step the playback forward by one simulation frame.

replay.filter.all.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Timeline filter: show every marked event. One word.

replay.filter.kills.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Timeline filter: show only destroyed-vehicle events. One word, a noun.

replay.filter.tank.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Timeline filter: show only events involving the tank the camera follows.

replay.indexing.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Status while the recording is read and its timeline built, before playback can start.

replay.refused.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Shown when a recording was made by another game version: {version} is a version string such as 2026.11.22. Replays only play on the version that recorded them.

replay.drifted.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Shown when playback stops early because the simulation diverged from the recording: {time} is a battle time as m:ss.

replay.unavailable.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. Shown when a recording is damaged or cannot be read.

replay.mark.kill.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. A timeline event: {actor} and {subject} are tank display names; the first destroyed the second. Past tense, as short as the English.

replay.mark.loss.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. A timeline event: {subject} (a tank display name) was destroyed with no other tank behind it (its crew scuttled it, or it fell). Past tense, as short as the English.

replay.mark.pen.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. A timeline event: {actor}'s shell penetrated the armour of {subject} (both tank display names). Armour penetration, not a generic verb.

replay.mark.fire.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. A timeline event: the tank {subject} (a display name) caught fire.

replay.mark.objective.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. A timeline event marker for a mode objective (a flag taken, a zone captured). One word.

replay.mark.strike.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. A timeline event marker: an air strike hit the battlefield.

replay.mark.respawn.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. A timeline event: the tank {subject} (a display name) came back into the battle after being destroyed.

replay.mark.ram.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. A timeline event: {actor} drove into {subject} (both tank display names) and damaged it.

replay.mark.end.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The replay viewer's control bar, which plays back a recorded solo battle. The last timeline marker: the battle ended.

settings.preset.note.auto.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. Settings, Graphics: the one-line note under a graphics quality level's preview, saying what that level changes. Keep the numbers, the × multipliers and the metre units exactly as written; "resolution" is the 3D render scale, "edge smoothing" is anti-aliasing, "light effects" are contact shadows, sun shafts and lens flare, "bloom" is the glow post effect, "ground textures" are the terrain's photo textures. The zh-CN, es, ja, de, pt-BR and ru strings were written by hand in the texture-diet-277 lane and await General Translation review.

garage.record.replayOpen.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. A button in the Service Record's Replays tab: opens a replay file from the player's device to watch it. "Replay" means a recorded playback of a battle; keep the same word as the tab. Short button label.

replay.import.notReplay.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. Shown in the Service Record's Replays tab when the file the player opened or dropped is not a replay of this game. Keep "Claude of Tanks" untranslated.

replay.import.format.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. Shown when a replay file was saved in another file format than this version of the game reads. {version} and {current} are format numbers (1, 2, ...), not game versions.

replay.import.tooBig.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. Shown when the file the player opened is far larger than any replay (over 2 MB), so it is not read.

replay.import.damaged.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. Shown when a replay file is cut short or corrupted and cannot be read.

replay.export.open.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. The film icon's label in the replay's control strip: opens the dialog. Short.

replay.export.title.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. The dialog's title. Short.

replay.export.close.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. The dialog's close button label (screen readers).

replay.export.size.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. A field label: the video's resolution (720p or 1080p). One word.

replay.export.rate.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. A field label: the video's frames per second (30 or 60).

replay.export.range.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. A field label: which part of the replay to export.

replay.export.rangeAll.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. An option: export the whole replay. {length} is its length as m:ss.

replay.export.rangeHere.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. An option: export from the current point of playback to the end. {from} and {to} are times as m:ss.

replay.export.hud.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. A checkbox: draw the game's on-screen display (HUD: minimap, team lists, score, kill feed) into the video. Keep "HUD" as is.

replay.export.noAudio.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. A plain note: the exported video has no sound in this version.

replay.export.long.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. A hint shown when a long replay is exported at the largest size and rate: the smaller size renders about twice as fast.

replay.export.unsupported.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. Shown when the player's browser cannot encode MP4 (H.264) video; the export button stays off. Keep "MP4", "Chrome" and "Edge" as is.

replay.export.start.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. The dialog's primary button: start the export. One word.

replay.export.cancel.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. The same button while the export runs: stop it. One word.

replay.export.progress.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. Progress while rendering: {frame} and {frames} are numbers.

replay.export.left.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. Estimated time remaining; {time} is m:ss. Shown after the progress line.

replay.export.done.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. After the export: the file was saved. {name} is the file name, {size} its size such as 18.7 MB.

replay.export.failed.context: Claude of Tanks, a browser tank game. The Export video dialog over a watched replay (a recorded battle): it renders the replay to an MP4 video file. The export stopped with an error; {reason} is the browser's message (often English).
